{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Deserving Gem''''' was a [[Hapan Battle Dragon]] and [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Ducha]] [[Requud]] during the [[Battle of Uroro Station]]. When [[SigTel|Hapan Signals Intelligence]] discovered communications between the ''Gem'' and [[Darth Caedus]]' flagship, ''[[Anakin Solo]]'', they supposed Requund were plotting to overthrow [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]].
